title.zh: 可能与必然被吸入：每个过程必然吸入的恰是不返回者；可能被吸入是在某一路径中失去自身，并允许返回
title.en: Possibly and necessarily drawn: every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return; possibly drawn is losing oneself on some course, and allows return

claim.zh: 区域外的配置可能被吸入区域（PossiblyDrawnInto），指从它出发的某个路径进入区域；必然被吸入（NecessarilyDrawnInto），指从它开始的每个运行都进入；被吸入（PossiblyDrawn、NecessarilyDrawn），指某个过程从不离开的区域（Frame.Invariant）如此吸入它。在确定的律下两者都是 P67 的（law_possibly_iff、law_necessarily_iff、law_drawn_iff）。返回的配置有一个从不失去它的运行，绕其路径永远回到它（Branching.Returns.run，构造性地）。所以每个过程必然吸入的恰是不返回者（necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns，Law.drawn_iff_not_returns 的实例）：必然被吸入者从不返回（NecessarilyDrawnInto.not_returns），不返回者在第一步必然被吸入它前方之处（necessarilyDrawnInto_ahead）。可能被吸入就是在某一路径中失去自身（possiblyDrawn_iff），沿该路径被锁定（PossiblyDrawnInto.never_back）；可能被吸入者可以在另一路径中返回：OneWay 的 false 可能而非必然被吸入 {true}，并且返回（OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily）。在确定的过程下，动作决定运行是否被吸入（Determined.moves_decide）。每个过程下未来变窄：n 步后可得者是过程从不离开的区域（reachable_invariant），失去的可能必然被吸入它（lost_necessarily_drawn）；在有限多配置中每个运行都进入返回者（Run.enters_returning），在有限多配置中，运行开始处的配置必然被吸入与不合并矛盾（NecessarilyDrawn.not_lossless，结论为 ¬ Lossless P，不给出 Merges 的见证）。对过程不成立的：返回者不是过程从不离开的区域（Transit.returning_not_invariant）；合并不必吸入两者之一（OneWay.merge_keeps）。在 Capture 中，规则保持自身时，具有给定规则的配置是律从不离开的区域（Law.rule_absorbing），下一配置也只依赖规则时，规则所持的配置固定（Law.held_absorbing），改革的状态在第一步被吸入它（Law.reform_drawnInto）；Captured 中的实例（Captured.rule_region_absorbing、Captured.held_absorbing、Captured.state_reform_drawn、Captured.rule_reform_drawn）。不加前提。
claim.en: A configuration outside a region is possibly drawn into it (PossiblyDrawnInto) where some course from it enters it, and necessarily drawn (NecessarilyDrawnInto) where every run from it does; drawn (PossiblyDrawn, NecessarilyDrawn) where some region the process never leaves (Frame.Invariant) so draws it. Under a determined law both are P67's (law_possibly_iff, law_necessarily_iff, law_drawn_iff). A configuration that returns has a run that never loses it, going round its course back to it forever (Branching.Returns.run, constructively). So every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return (necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns, the instance of Law.drawn_iff_not_returns): what is necessarily drawn never returns (NecessarilyDrawnInto.not_returns), and what does not return is necessarily drawn into what lies ahead of it at the first step (necessarilyDrawnInto_ahead). Possibly drawn is losing oneself on some course (possiblyDrawn_iff), locked in along that course (PossiblyDrawnInto.never_back); a configuration possibly drawn may return on another course: OneWay's false is possibly but not necessarily drawn into {true}, and returns (OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily). Under a determined process the moves decide whether a run is drawn in (Determined.moves_decide). Under every process the future narrows: what can be had n steps on is a region the process never leaves (reachable_invariant), and a lost possibility is necessarily drawn into it (lost_necessarily_drawn); within finitely many configurations every run enters what returns (Run.enters_returning), and within finitely many configurations a necessarily drawn starting configuration of a given run contradicts losslessness (NecessarilyDrawn.not_lossless, concluding ¬ Lossless P rather than supplying a witness of Merges). What fails for processes: what returns is not a region the process never leaves (Transit.returning_not_invariant); a merge need draw neither of the two (OneWay.merge_keeps). In Capture, where the rule keeps itself, the configurations with a given rule are a region the law never leaves (Law.rule_absorbing); where the next configuration also depends on the rule alone, the configuration the rule holds is fixed (Law.held_absorbing), and a reformed state is drawn into it at the first step (Law.reform_drawnInto); the instances in Captured (Captured.rule_region_absorbing, Captured.held_absorbing, Captured.state_reform_drawn, Captured.rule_reform_drawn). No premise.

hypotheses.zh: 没有运行开始的配置（死路）空洞地必然被吸入每个不含它的区域，因为核心的运行不终止。
hypotheses.en: A configuration from which no run begins (a dead end) is necessarily drawn into every region not containing it, vacuously, as the core's runs are unending.

correspondence.zh: P81（工作板），同上；P67 的吸引对不确定的过程。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：可能与必然被吸入恰在路径开放处分开：一个配置可以在一个路径中被吸入而在另一个中回来；每个路径都吸入的是不返回者，某个路径吸入的是能失去自身者。Capture 读作吸引：只改革状态被吸回规则所持之处，吸引子只随规则移动。见整合文档 §99。
correspondence.en: P81 (work board), as above; P67's attraction for processes that are not determined. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): possibly and necessarily drawn come apart exactly where the course is open: a configuration can be drawn in on one course and come back on another; what every course draws in is what does not return, what some course draws in is what can lose itself. Capture read as attraction: reform of the state alone is drawn back into what the rule holds, and the attractor moves only with the rule. See the integration document §99.

detail.zh: 复用 P67 的 Law.DrawnInto、Law.Drawn 与 Law.drawn_iff_not_returns；确定的律下新概念就是它们。
detail.en: Reuses P67's Law.DrawnInto, Law.Drawn and Law.drawn_iff_not_returns; under a determined law the new notions are these.

input.en: Possibly and necessarily drawn for every process.

detail.en: Reuses Capture's Captured and Law.reform_reabsorbed, as instances of attracting regions.

input.zh: 规则区域作为吸收区域。
input.en: The rule region as an absorbing region.

detail.en: The same module's Returns and Reachable.

input.en: The equivalence of drawing and not returning.

detail.zh: 同一模块：确定性在相同之下。
detail.en: The same module: determinacy up to likeness.

detail.zh: OneWay：可能而非必然被吸入，并且返回；Transit：返回者不是不变区域。
detail.en: OneWay: possibly but not necessarily drawn, and returns; Transit: what returns is not an invariant region.

limitations.zh: 不陈述在界内被吸入；不给分支路径上的度量（见 P82）；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Being drawn in within a bound is not stated; no measure on branching courses is given (see P82); the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; no ethical predicate occurs.

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 119 theorems of Becoming.Branching all have empty axiom reports, among them Branching.necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns, Branching.NecessarilyDrawnInto.not_returns, Branching.necessarilyDrawnInto_ahead, Branching.possiblyDrawn_iff, Branching.PossiblyDrawnInto.never_back, Branching.OneWay.possibly_not_necessarily, Branching.reachable_invariant, Branching.lost_necessarily_drawn, Run.enters_returning, Law.rule_absorbing, Law.reform_drawnInto and Captured.state_reform_drawn. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).
